tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H ≤ 0.48, while the target horizon is 20.3. The recalled sink-coupled mechanism specifically identifies a slow-horizon observation as necessary to distinguish and estimate the adaptation term.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation reliably at the target horizon of 20.3.
A finer short trajectory is less directly informative about long-horizon adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal and periodic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-window pilot does not distinguish these mechanisms from sink-coupled adaptation; the slow-horizon probe can resolve that ambiguity.
